scenes.learningTarget: Democrat Mary Peltola won Alaska's at-large seat August 16, 2022 after Republican Don Young died.

incorrect.speaker: npc:0

evidence.claim: Democrat Mary Peltola won Alaska's at-large seat August 16, 2022 after Republican Don Young died.
